LESSON: PILLARS OF SWALAH

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Devotional Acts
Topic 4.3: Pillars of Swalah

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Pillars of Swalah
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What do you recite when praying?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify the pillars of prayers for validity of swalah
2. apply the pillars of swalah correctly in daily prayers
3. appreciate the need for observing the pillars of swalah by emulating the Sunnah of the Prophet (S.A.W.)

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: identify the pillars of prayers for validity of swalah

Teach

▸ Skill 3: appreciate the need for observing the pillars of swalah by emulating the Sunnah of the Prophet (S.A.W.)

Try this

• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: identify the pillars of prayers for validity of swalah
• Model 2: apply the pillars of swalah correctly in daily prayers
• Model 3: appreciate the need for observing the pillars of swalah by emulating the Sunnah of the Prophet (S.A.W.)

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: identify the pillars of prayers for validity of swalah
2. Practise: apply the pillars of swalah correctly in daily prayers

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Pillars of Swalah.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What do you recite when praying?
2. Which postures are performed in prayers?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• identify the pillars of prayers for validity of swalah
• apply the pillars of swalah correctly in daily prayers
